Profile loaded/editable account state requires a verified session and explicit profiles-versus-customers source and linking rules; guest and data-template states only are validated.

Saved payment-instrument management is unsupported by the current model/provider contract; only the informational Account page is validated.

Owner/Admin catalog and prices needs authorized store-scoped loading and editing, current-price and history semantics, publication validation, images and concurrency/error states; only the data-pending overview is validated.
